settings.title: General Settings
settings.instructions_empty: No instructions configured. Click to add.
settings.instruction_content_placeholder: Instruction content, leave empty to save path only

subagents_max_concurrent.label: Max Concurrent Subagents
subagents_max_concurrent.help: Maximum number of concurrently active subagents, default 20, limit 1~20.

subagents_token_budget.label: Token Budget
subagents_token_budget.help: Context token budget per subagent step. Default 200000.

subagents_api_timeout_secs.label: API Timeout
subagents_api_timeout_secs.help: Timeout for a single model call by a subagent, default 120s, range 1~1800.

subagents_heartbeat_timeout_secs.label: Heartbeat Timeout
subagents_heartbeat_timeout_secs.help: How long a subagent with no response is considered zombie and cleaned up, default 300s, range 30~3600, must be greater than api_timeout_secs.

subagents_default_model.label: Default Subagent Model
subagents_default_model.help: Fallback model when no role is specified.

settings.reset_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to restore all settings to default? Unsaved changes will be lost.
settings.reset_success: Restored to defaults, please remember to save

help.allow_shell: Whether to allow shell tools. Available when true, but still controlled by approval_policy; false completely hides the exec_shell tool.
help.approval_policy: Popup approval strategy before tool execution. on-request confirms each request, untrusted only confirms untrusted operations, never never pops up.
help.auto_compact: Model-aware, enabled by default. Automatically generates a summary and replaces old content when context approaches the model window limit.
help.auto_compact_threshold_percent: Default 80. Triggers auto-compaction when active request input estimation reaches this percentage of the model context window.
help.background_color: Custom background color for TUI root, header, conversation history, and footer; default uses the theme default.
help.cost_currency: Cost display currency. usd for USD, cny/rmb/yuan are normalized to CNY.
help.default_mode: Default mode. agent for normal conversation, plan for planning mode, yolo for direct output mode.
help.default_model_override: Override the default model selection for the current provider. Not yet configurable, support in future versions.
help.default_text_model: Default text model. e.g. deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash.
help.features_apply_patch: Enable the apply_patch tool, supporting unified diff format batch modifications.
help.features_exec_policy: Enable the execution policy engine to perform permission checks and approval on tool calls.
help.features_mcp: Enable Model Context Protocol support, allowing connections to external MCP servers to extend the toolset.
help.features_shell_tool: Enable the exec_shell tool to allow executing shell commands.
help.features_vision_model: When enabled, an independent image analysis model can be configured via [vision_model]; requires manual activation.
help.features_web_search: Enable web_search and compatible alias web.run, defaults to DuckDuckGo.
help.max_history: Number of submitted input history to retain, cleared drafts are still kept for history search, default 1000.
help.mention_menu_behavior: Menu behavior when @mentioning files. fuzzy for fuzzy search, browser to list subdirectories in the current directory.
help.mention_menu_limit: Maximum number of candidate files to keep in the @ popup, excess is truncated, default 128.
help.mention_walk_depth: Maximum directory depth for @ completion to traverse the workspace. 0 means unlimited depth, default 6.
help.notifications_completion_sound: Completion sound. beep for system default beep, off to disable, bell for terminal bell, file to play custom WAV.
help.notifications_method: Completion notification method. auto selects automatically by terminal, osc9 sends OSC 9, bel sends terminal bell, off disables notifications.
help.notifications_threshold_secs: Only triggers notification for successfully completed turns with duration ≥ this value, default 30s. Failed/cancelled turns are always silent.
help.paste_burst_detection: Enabled by default. Detects bulk paste in terminals that do not support bracketed-paste, preventing character-by-character completion triggers.
help.retry_enabled: Whether to automatically retry on API request failure.
help.retry_exponential_base: Multiply each retry delay by this base, default 2.0 (1s → 2s → 4s → 8s...).
help.retry_initial_delay: Wait time before the first retry (seconds), default 1.0.
help.retry_max_delay: Upper limit for backoff delay (seconds), preventing unlimited growth, default 60.0.
help.retry_max_retries: Maximum retries for a single request before reporting an error, default 3.
help.sandbox_mode: File system access sandbox. read-only is the strictest, workspace-write allows writes within the workspace, danger-full-access has no limits, external-sandbox relies on external tool isolation.
help.search_base_url: DuckDuckGo-compatible custom search endpoint; must be configured for SearXNG.
help.search_provider: Search backend. DuckDuckGo requires no API Key; other options require the corresponding API Key or configuration.
help.show_thinking: Whether to display the model's reasoning/thinking content in conversation history.
help.show_tool_details: Whether to expand and display detailed parameters and results for each tool call.
help.sidebar_focus: Sidebar focus behavior. pinned keeps the sidebar fixed, auto toggles visibility, tasks, agents, context, hidden.
help.theme: Interface theme. Choose to follow the system, light, dark, etc.
help.tui_alternate_screen: Alternate screen strategy. auto automatically, always always on, never never; interactive sessions are usually taken over by the TUI alternate screen.
help.tui_mouse_capture: When enabled, supports internal scrolling, conversation selection, right-click menu, and scrollbar dragging; some terminals disable this by default.
help.tui_osc8_links: Wraps URLs with OSC 8 escape sequences, supporting Cmd+click navigation in iTerm2/Ghostty/Kitty/WezTerm.
help.tui_stream_chunk_timeout_secs: Maximum idle time between two data chunks in the SSE stream, default 300s, range 1~3600, 0 maps to the default value.
help.tui_terminal_probe_timeout_ms: Timeout for probing terminal mode (color, mouse protocol) at startup, default 500ms, range 100~5000.
help.update_check_for_updates: Check for updates on startup. Checks the latest stable version in the background and shows a toast when a new version with complete resources is available.
help.verbosity: Output verbosity. normal for standard conversation style, concise for brief low-redundancy output.
help.language: Switch the interface display language, saved directly in the CodeWhale configuration file.

reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.help: Reasoning effort. off/low/medium/high/max/xhigh/ultracode control thinking depth. Not yet configurable, support in future versions.

enabled.label: Enable Fin Fast Path Management
enabled.help: Enable Fin Fast Path Management. Fin uses deepseek-v4-flash to perform coordination work, reducing the burden on the main model. Not yet configurable.

verbatim_window_turns.label: Verbatim Window Turns
verbatim_window_turns.help: Number of recent conversation turns to keep in full original text; earlier turns are compressed or summarized, default 16. Not yet configurable.

l1_threshold.label: L1 Context Pressure Threshold
l1_threshold.help: Level 1 context pressure threshold (tokens), triggers lightweight intervention when exceeded, default 192000. Not yet configurable.

l2_threshold.label: L2 Context Pressure Threshold
l2_threshold.help: Level 2 threshold; more aggressive compression strategy when exceeded, default 384000. Not yet configurable.

l3_threshold.label: L3 Context Pressure Threshold
l3_threshold.help: Level 3 threshold; emergency handling line when approaching model limit, default 576000. Not yet configurable.

seam_model.label: Seam Model
seam_model.help: Model for performing context coordination tasks, default deepseek-v4-flash. Not yet configurable.

CODEWHALE_CACHE_MAXIMAL.label: Cache Maximal Mode
CODEWHALE_CACHE_MAXIMAL.help: When enabled, injects the full content of active files into the system prompt each turn, leveraging KV prefix cache hits. Default 24KB per file / 96KB total. Not yet configurable.

update_uri.label: Custom Update Mirror
update_uri.help: Custom update mirror; must return GitHub-compatible latest-release JSON. Not yet configurable.

toml.label: Permissions Rules File
toml.help: Co-located permission rules file, supports tool + command/path fields, used for forced approval or rejection. Not yet configurable.

skills_dir.label: Skills Directory
skills_dir.help: Skills directory, default ~/.codewhale/skills; workspace-local .agents/skills or ./skills take priority. Not yet configurable.

scan_codewhale_only.label: Scan CodeWhale Skills Only
scan_codewhale_only.help: When set to true, ignores cross-tool root directories like .claude/skills, .cursor/skills, default false. Not yet configurable.

mcp_config_path.label: MCP Config File Path
mcp_config_path.help: MCP server config file path; restart TUI after modification. Not yet configurable.

notes_path.label: Notes File Path
notes_path.help: Note file path used by the model-visible note tool. Not yet configurable.

memory_path.label: Memory File Path
memory_path.help: User memory file path. Not yet configurable.

enabled.label: Enable Memory
enabled.help: When enabled, TUI loads the memory file into the <user_memory> prompt block, default false. Not yet configurable.

enabled.label: Enable Snapshots
enabled.help: Creates side-git snapshots for file modifications, supports rollback, default true. Not yet configurable.

max_age_days.label: Snapshot Max Age (Days)
max_age_days.help: Snapshot retention days; auto-cleaned when exceeded, default 7. Not yet configurable.

enabled.label: Enable Verifier
enabled.help: When enabled, automatically runs a verifier preview check when the model claims completion, default false. Not yet configurable.

verdict_policy.label: Verifier Verdict Policy
verdict_policy.help: Verifier verdict policy; currently the only strategy is hunt. Not yet configurable.

enabled.label: Enable Capacity Controller
enabled.help: Experimental capacity controller. When enabled, actively intervenes when context approaches the upper limit; may change conversation history, default false. Not yet configurable.

low_risk_max.label: Low Risk Max Ratio
low_risk_max.help: Context usage below this ratio is considered low risk, default 0.50. Not yet configurable.

medium_risk_max.label: Medium Risk Max Ratio
medium_risk_max.help: Usage in this range is medium risk and starts alerting, default 0.62. Not yet configurable.

severe_min_slack.label: Severe Min Slack
severe_min_slack.help: Negative values allow brief overspend but trigger emergency compaction, default -0.25. Not yet configurable.

severe_violation_ratio.label: Severe Violation Ratio
severe_violation_ratio.help: When actual usage exceeds expected ratio by this value, it is considered a severe violation, default 0.40. Not yet configurable.

refresh_cooldown_turns.label: Refresh Cooldown Turns
refresh_cooldown_turns.help: Minimum number of turns between two context refresh operations, default 6. Not yet configurable.

replan_cooldown_turns.label: Replan Cooldown Turns
replan_cooldown_turns.help: Minimum number of turns between two replans, default 5. Not yet configurable.

max_replay_per_turn.label: Max Replay Per Turn
max_replay_per_turn.help: Maximum number of times to replay historical content into the prompt per turn, default 1. Not yet configurable.

min_turns_before_guardrail.label: Min Turns Before Guardrail
min_turns_before_guardrail.help: Minimum number of turns after session start before enabling capacity guardrails, default 4. Not yet configurable.

profile_window.label: Profile Window
profile_window.help: Number of recent turns the capacity controller analyzes for token usage trends, default 8. Not yet configurable.

deepseek_v3_2_chat_prior.label: V3.2 Chat Priority
deepseek_v3_2_chat_prior.help: Context priority weight for the V3.2 Chat model, default 3.9. Not yet configurable.

deepseek_v3_2_reasoner_prior.label: V3.2 Reasoner Priority
deepseek_v3_2_reasoner_prior.help: Context priority weight for the V3.2 Reasoner model, default 4.1. Not yet configurable.

deepseek_v4_pro_prior.label: V4 Pro Priority
deepseek_v4_pro_prior.help: Context priority weight for V4 Pro, default 3.5. Not yet configurable.

deepseek_v4_flash_prior.label: V4 Flash Priority
deepseek_v4_flash_prior.help: Context priority weight for V4 Flash, default 4.2. Not yet configurable.

fallback_default_prior.label: Fallback Default Priority
fallback_default_prior.help: Default context priority weight for unknown models, default 3.8. Not yet configurable.

max_depth.label: Max Depth
max_depth.help: Maximum hierarchy depth for subagent recursive delegation. Not yet configurable.

launch_concurrency.label: Launch Concurrency
launch_concurrency.help: How many subagents to launch simultaneously per turn before queuing the rest; defaults to max_subagents. Not yet configurable.

max_admitted.label: Max Admitted
max_admitted.help: Total upper limit for subagents including running and queued, default 200. Not yet configurable.

worker_model.label: Worker Model
worker_model.help: Worker role subagent model. Not yet configurable.

explorer_model.label: Explorer Model
explorer_model.help: Explorer role subagent model. Not yet configurable.

awaiter_model.label: Awaiter Model
awaiter_model.help: Awaiter role subagent model. Not yet configurable.

review_model.label: Review Model
review_model.help: Review role subagent model. Not yet configurable.

custom_model.label: Custom Model
custom_model.help: Custom role subagent model. Not yet configurable.

include_summary.label: Include Summary
include_summary.help: When enabled, notifications include duration and estimated cost for that turn, default false. Not yet configurable.

sound_file.label: Sound File
sound_file.help: Custom WAV sound file path; only used on Windows when completion_sound is file. Not yet configurable.
